text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: And so, young Umayama and Musunoumi continue training deep into the night with the future of their sumo stable firmly on their shoulders…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That was so moving! Dosukoi! The Youth of Sumo is such a good movie! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thanks for letting us use your TV!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What did you think of the movie, Biko? Didn't Umayama and Musunoumi's rivalry get you fired up?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right, Bono! Come at me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Charge at me with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: …What?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Don't hold back! Run at me and shove me as hard as you can!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I don't think that's a good idea. You might get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I want to wrestle with you at full strength! I wanna be like Umayama and Musunoumi!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I wanna grow strong, just like how they grew big! Lend me your strength, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Umm, I know you want to get stronger, but I'm afraid I might send you flying through the roof if I really charged into you…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh?! I-I don't want that happening! Okay, then let's compete in something that you don't have to hold back in!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How about we do an eating contest? We can compete either in speed or quantity. I can do both!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: An eating contest? That does sound safer…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An eating contest is safer, but I feel like changing the competition so much makes it lose its original intent. Still, I need to answer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll get the food ready.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: They usually use hot dogs for speed eating contests, but we don't have any, so let's use yakisoba dogs!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! First one to eat ten wins! I won't lose, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, they start shoveling yakisoba dogs into their mouths… And the winner is…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wow, I won?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Dang it! I was sure I could eat faster…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both started off strong, but Hishi Akebono got a second wind halfway through and chowed her way quickly to victory!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Darn it! I can't even hold a candle against you when it comes to eating!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I think I only won because I have a big mouth, and I was able to take bigger bites! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: …Hm? It's true! You do have massive jaws!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Speaking of, I'm still a bit hungry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And you look pretty tasty, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What?! N-no, I'm not! Don't eat meee!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, come back here! Lemme season you with soy sauce! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Knock that off, Bono! What do you think you're—ahaha! T-tickling's no fair!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! It's just a little trick to bring out the flavor. Tickle, tickle! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The competition results go out the window, along with peals of clear laughter from the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: YES! Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Biko! You were really fast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono puts up a good fight, but Biko Pegasus's tenacity wins out.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Speed eating is a specialty of mine! I've been refining it for years!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It'd be rude to eat while watching Carrot Ranger, you see…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So I got into the habit of scarfing all my meals down! My mom wasn't very happy about it, though…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You must really love Carrot Ranger! Speed eating is your weapon! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: My weapon… Yes, that's it! Now, to hone it even further!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll help by making lots and lots of yakisoba dogs for you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're always so reliable, Bono! You're just like Dr. Veggie!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right, let's become the fastest speed eaters who have ever lived!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't think they're on the same page, but anyway… I warn them to chew their food thoroughly and watch over their competition.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll get the food ready.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I made tons of meat buns, so eat as many as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wow! They look steaming hot and delicious! Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They start shoveling meat buns into their mouths… And the winner is…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That was tasty! ☆ Whew, I'm stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-I can't eat another bite…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono claims an overwhelming victory with her triple-bun devouring technique.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: …? About what?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I wanted to have a pulse-pounding battle with you, just like Umayama and Musunoumi… But I failed you.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I'm not good enough to be your rival! Ugh, the shame!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Then come back stronger and win next time, Carrot Ranger!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: …! I know that line… It's from the episode where Carrot Ranger faced off against her ultimate rival, Cucumber Ranger!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Each time you battle me, I become stronger… So, I say to you, Carrot Ranger!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Come and challenge me as many times as you'd like, so long as the flame of justice burns in your heart!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I get it now…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Umayama and Musunoumi were Carrot Ranger and Cucumber Ranger all along!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They're really similar, right? But Biko, remember this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You can challenge me again anytime. I'll always be happy to take you on!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: …I will! And next time, we'll settle this with rice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Hishi Akebono's bond with Biko Pegasus grows even stronger thanks to their little competition.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's fifty-five! Trainer, another meat bun, please! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A-another one for me… too… Urgh.
choice_data_list: Competitors, put your meat buns down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay, I won! Um, are you okay, Biko? Does your tummy hurt?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thankfully, the match was called with my stomach at 95% capacity, so I'll be fine…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I'm so mad at myself! I could've fit another half a bun before reaching my limit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Then how about we have dessert instead?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm still hungry, so let's eat until we're both full!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let me know if you have any requests, and I'll make it for you! Oh! How does a whole bucket of almond tofu sound?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: B-Bono, please have mercy! I was just trying to sound tough! I'm actually full to bursting!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Really? But I bet your dessert stomach's still empty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, their eating contest comes to a close, with Hishi Akebono as the clear winner.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm! ♪ They're so plump, fluffy, and tasty!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You made these, Bono?! They sure are fluffy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Since I was already cooking, I decided to steam some soup dumplings and shumai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Would you like some?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Definitely! I'd be happy to help you out!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Everything was so delicious! Chinese food is so buono and flavorful! I love it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! We sure ate a lot. I'm too full to get up…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Did you like them too, Trainer? What a nice, fulfilling meal that was! ♪

text_block_list.name: Bono and Biko
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …The two got so distracted by the food that they completely forgot to keep score.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But why?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm worried the two of them will lose themselves in the heat of the moment and get hurt, but I don't want to be rude and say it too bluntly.
choice_data_list: Because you're already competing with each other!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That sounds cool… But what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm, I think Trainer is talking about our feelings.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You want to grapple and wrestle with me with all your might.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And that's just like how everything started when Umayama challenged Musunoumi.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Does this mean what I think it means, then?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. It means you've already taken the first step toward getting stronger, Biko.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: W-well, then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Why don't we go for a run to see if it's true?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the competition is called off, and the two of them instead head over to the track together.
